title: Daily Check-In (Partners)
summary: How partners submit their daily check-in and see their attendance.

blocks.heading: Your daily check-in
paragraphs: Partners submit their daily check-in here before the deadline. Your status (On Time / Late) and attendance are tracked automatically.
Use the tabs to switch between Time Tracking, your Check-In, and Off Days.

blocks.caption: The Daily Check-In screen
blocks.alt: The partner daily check-in screen with the Check-In tab, Check In button and status highlighted
